title: TaskMutationRequest
description: Wire shape consumed by the Task Access Layer's mutation API. One narrowly-typed mutation per call so the layer can enforce single-state-machine authority on lane moves separately from field edits and timeline appends. Mirrors backend/Services/TaskAccess/TaskAccessRecords.cs. Phase 1 schema; mutations are implemented in phase 3.

jobId.description: Target job slug. Combined with watchPath this addresses exactly one record in the index.

watchPath.description: Resolved watch path that owns the job. Optional when jobId is unique across all watched projects; required to disambiguate otherwise.

kind.description: Mutation discriminator. Lane transitions are a separate request shape (TaskTransitionRequest) so the state machine has its own typed entry point.

fieldName.description: Field name when kind is UpdateField. Matches one of the writable JobInfo fields (model, cliType, title, useOwnSession, commit, contextUsage, ...).

fieldValue.description: New field value when kind is UpdateField. Always passed as a JSON-encoded string so the wire shape stays uniform across primitive and complex fields; the layer parses according to fieldName.

promptMarkdown.description: Markdown body when kind is AttachPrompt. Extends the prompt-N.md timeline (ADR-0003); never overwrites prompt.md.

logLine.description: One line to append to the job's session-events.jsonl when kind is AppendLogLine.

expectedVersion.description: Optimistic-concurrency token previously handed out by a find / list / snapshot call. When set, the layer rejects the mutation with status Conflict if the indexed version has moved on.
